title: Synthesis of New Axially Coumarin Disubstituted Silicon(IV) Phthalocyanines, Investigation of their DNA-Binding Properties and Inhibitory Activities on Ache and Buche.
authors: Gunes, Ahmet; Meletli, Furkan; Danis, Ozkan; Agirtas, Mehmet Salih; Yalcin, Bahattin
one_liner_zh: 该文合成香豆素取代硅酞菁并研究其DNA结合与酶抑制活性，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但核心为光动力治疗药物开发，非TF-DNA互作机制研究，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: In this study, we report on the synthesis and characterization of new silicon (IV) phthalocyanine compounds (SiPcs) axially substituted with coumarin-linked derivatives, designed for potential application in photodynamic therapy (PDT) due to their photophysical properties. METHODS: Characterization was carried out using FT-IR, UV-Vis, MALDI-TOF-MS, and (1)H NMR spectroscopy. In dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), the SiPcs produced singlet oxygen with quantum yields of 0.17 to 0.19, assessed by the DPBF quenching method. DNA binding studies via UV-Vis spectroscopy and molecular docking suggested high binding affinities (DeltaG(0) values between -9.90 to -10.4 kcal/mol) and stable interactions with calf thymus DNA (ct-DNA). RESULTS: The compounds showed promising inhibitory activity against acetylcholinesterase (AChE) and butyrylcholinesterase (BuChE), with IC(50) values indicating higher potency and selectivity compared to galantamine, a known cholinesterase inhibitor. CONCLUSION: The combined singlet oxygen generation, DNA binding, and enzyme inhibition data underscore the potential of these SiPc-coumarin derivatives as multifunctional agents for PDT and neuroprotective applications such as Alzheimer's disease (AD).
abstract_zh: 引言：在本研究中，我们报道了新型硅(IV)酞菁化合物（SiPcs）的合成与表征，这些化合物轴向取代有香豆素连接的衍生物，因其光物理性质而设计用于光动力疗法（PDT）的潜在应用。方法：使用FT-IR、UV-Vis、MALDI-TOF-MS和(1)H NMR光谱进行表征。在二甲亚砜（DMSO）中，SiPcs产生单线态氧，量子产率为0.17至0.19，通过DPBF淬灭法评估。通过UV-Vis光谱和分子对接进行的DNA结合研究表明，与小牛胸腺DNA（ct-DNA）具有高结合亲和力（DeltaG(0)值在-9.90至-10.4 kcal/mol之间）和稳定相互作用。结果：这些化合物对乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）和丁酰胆碱酯酶（BuChE）显示出有前景的抑制活性，IC(50)值表明其效力和选择性高于已知胆碱酯酶抑制剂加兰他敏。结论：单线态氧生成、DNA结合和酶抑制数据的综合结果强调了这些SiPc-香豆素衍生物作为多功能剂在PDT和神经保护应用（如阿尔茨海默病（AD））中的潜力。
